text: Grocery prices made me want to see them underwater.
Wife said 'quick trip.' I packed for a deep dive.
Onion aisle was crying. I came prepared this time.
Going in for milk. Might not surface before Friday.
Sale on snacks. Pressure from the kids is real.
Checking the bill before checkout? Brace for impact.
Bought the 'family size.' Now I'm the one drowning.
